test_title: PYST 25: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 17 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The new technology proved to be quite efficient in __streamlining__ daily tasks.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e., 'simplifying'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "streamlining" **means to make a process or system more easy.

 
 
• **Example:** The company decided to streamline its service process by implementing an automated chat bot to handle common inquiries.
 
 
 
• **"Simplifying"** refers to making something easier to do or understand. (सरल बनाना)
 
 
• **Example:** The software is very effective in simplifying complex calculations.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **simplifying**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sojourning** (अस्थायी प्रवास): Staying somewhere temporarily.

 
 
• **Example:** He is sojourning at a friend's house until he finds a new apartment.
 
 
 
• **Startling** (चौंकाने वाला): Very surprising, astonishing, or remarkable.
 
 
• **Example:** The news of his resignation was startling to everyone.
 
 
 
• **Stripling** (युवक): A youth in the early stages of development.
 
 
• **Example:** The stripling aspired to become a great warrior like his father.
 
 

32:Tb23,

The correct answer is: **Option 1** i
